about: Verified company names used by the optional alias check. Names are added only with a source. Different legal companies stay separate identities; a search group joins them only when chosen on purpose.

tata_motors_pv.business: Passenger cars, electric vehicles and Jaguar Land Rover

jaguar_land_rover.business: Luxury cars and SUVs under the Jaguar, Range Rover, Defender and Discovery brands

names_needing_context.name: Jaguar
names_needing_context.why: Jaguar alone can mean the animal, a fighter jet or a sports team, so it counts only when the same text also has a general car word.

reliance_industries.business: Oil-to-chemicals (refining, fuels, petrochemicals), oil and gas, and the parent of the digital, retail and new energy businesses

jio_platforms.business: Telecom and digital services through Reliance Jio Infocomm; listed on 28 October 2026, still controlled by Reliance Industries

reliance_retail.business: Retail stores and online shopping through Reliance Retail

reliance_consumer_products.business: Consumer brands (food, drinks and personal care)

reliance_new_energy.business: Solar, batteries and other new energy businesses

tata motors.note: Since the demerger (effective 1 October 2025) there are two listed companies. News uses "Tata Motors" for both, so a search for Tata Motors covers both identities, and Jaguar Land Rover, which belongs to the passenger vehicle company. "Tata" alone is not used: it also matches other Tata Group companies such as Tata Steel and Tata Elxsi.

reliance industries.note: Reliance Industries and the companies it controls, from its own list of subsidiaries. Control decides, not a separate listing. "Reliance" alone is not used: it also matches separate companies such as Reliance Power and Reliance Infrastructure. Jio Financial Services is a separate listed company and is not in this group.
